parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked that the reported sink (getline(secret_file, password)) is not used in any OS command execution context. The password string is only passed to libcurl via CURLOPT_PASSWORD, which internally handles authentication over SMTP. No system(), exec(), or similar functions are invoked with the password. Therefore, even if the file 'secret' contains arbitrary content, it cannot be interpreted as a command by the program. The code does not construct or execute shell commands, so OS Command Injection is not possible.
